scope: Repository projection of the reviewed Solaris 604 source import. Records original path, hash and tracked destination for every imported file. It is not a manifest of the complete 604 handoff and not evidence of build, security or production readiness.

transport.verified: Computed SHA-256 matched the expected value and the adjacent checksum file before extraction.
transport.note: The archive was authorized as a one-time Git transport and removed from the working tree after verified extraction. Its earlier Git object remains in branch history; history was not rewritten.

full_reference.note: The four Solaris-Android-604-Handoff-Part-N-of-4.zip backups remain the complete private reference and are deliberately outside this repository.

excluded_categories.private-evidence-excluded: Private phone evidence. Filenames and hashes are deliberately not reproduced here.
excluded_categories.binary-or-asset-excluded: APK, HBC, DEX, native library, model and other binary inputs.
excluded_categories.third-party-dependency-excluded: Bundled node_modules; exact copies and notices remain in the complete backup.
excluded_categories.historical-reference-excluded: Full host disassembly and most archived 601 recovery material.
excluded_categories.full-reference-inventory-excluded: Complete-handoff manifests, which would falsely appear to gate a partial clone.
excluded_categories.full-reference-runner-or-evidence-exclud: Complete-handoff verifier/audit runners and their evidence.
excluded_categories.external-build-input-excluded: Reconstruction inputs, reconstruction work and release directories.
excluded_categories.optional-probe-input-excluded: Optional native-probe runtime, model weight and acquired inputs.
excluded_categories.root-reference-excluded: Original root reference files replaced by transport-aware instructions.

deliberately_edited_documentation.note: New product README for this repository, adapted from the reviewed setup README draft. The frozen pack README is preserved at docs/provenance/import-pack/README.md.
New repository agent instructions. The frozen pack AGENTS.md is preserved at docs/provenance/import-pack/AGENTS.md.
New Claude pointer file importing AGENTS.md. The frozen pack CLAUDE.md is preserved at docs/provenance/import-pack/CLAUDE.md.

Starts from the frozen pack's exact .gitignore, then adds repository-projection rules and re-includes the five retained build-inputs JSON descriptors that the full-handoff rule would otherwise drop. The frozen copy is at docs/provenance/import-pack/dot-gitignore.

not_established_by_this_manifest: Application security, licensing clearance or third-party redistribution rights.
Native Gradle/application build completeness or reproducibility.
Any newly executed APK build, installation, signing or device test.

files.rename_reason: Stored without the leading dot so its ignore rules do not take effect inside the provenance folder. Bytes are unchanged and still hash-verified.
